params.body:
Restack of #358 (`workbench/ui/relation-picker-3`; replaces #376 and #384) on the one-file-per-finding layout. **Merge order: #368, #369, #370 (the layout), then #374 (average price), then this one.** The gateway pushes each PR as a snapshot of its own files on top of main, so this diff shows only this PR's files; there is no overlap with #374.

Same change as #358, with these differences:

- The two findings it added as X-128 and X-129 are files in `docs/bedrijfsregels/bevindingen/` (no number, named by slug): `2026-09-14-relatiekiezer-begint-schoon.md` and `2026-09-14-relatiekiezer-op-een-telefoon.md`, both opgelost. `RelationPickerTest` refers to them by slug.
- Its copy of X-127 and of R P1-1.15 / R S5-3.11 (the phone rules) is dropped: they landed on main with the mobile PR and are identical. R P2-5.9 and R P2-5.10 are new and free on main (P2-5 ends at .8 there).

No rule renumbered. Merged by hand with #381 (list headers on a phone), which landed in between: the picker table now reads `class="ui-list ui-list-titled{{ $isModal ? ' ui-picker' : '' }}"`, so the relations page itself still emits exactly `<table class="ui-list ui-list-titled">` (the literal `ListPageHeadersTest` from #381 asserts on; #384 left a trailing space and failed it; the test is unchanged), and the picker block in refresh.css sits after the list-headers block; worth one look on a phone. Checked locally on top of #370 and #374: `RulesIdentityTest`, `RulesDocsBuildTest`, `RulesCoverageTest`, `RelationPickerTest`, `StylesheetSyntaxTest` (19 tests, 681 assertions, OK). Shane closes the original.
params.title: The relation picker opens clean and fits a phone (restacked)
